clue.text: Definitive statement, and the most up to date

definitions.meaning: a final, conclusive remark that settles an argument
the newest fashion, as in 'the ultimate in style'

explanation.definitionFit: A closing remark nobody can top is a final one; the very latest trend is likewise called this, as in 'the latest in luxury'.

clue.text: Sub-humans imprison me in a beastly enclosure

indicators.note: the words for a beastly enclosure lock up me, so me goes inside them

parts.note: a pen is an enclosure for animals

explanation.surface: Primitive creatures lock someone up in an animal pen.
explanation.definitionFit: Ape-men are hypothetical creatures between apes and humans, hence less than human.

clue.text: Sum of a pound presented to a young child

indicators.note: a pound is given to the child, so the child comes first and the gift follows

parts.note: a tot is a small child
L, from Latin libra, is the abbreviation for pound

explanation.surface: Giving a toddler a pound is the full amount.
explanation.definitionFit: A total is the whole amount reached by adding.

clue.text: He suits people away from home and in better health

parts.note: out means not at home
fitter means healthier

explanation.surface: A tailor who travels and keeps fit.
explanation.definitionFit: An outfitter supplies clothes, providing customers with suits.

clue.text: Landed widow urges one to have a flutter

definitions.meaning: a widow holding property or a title from her late husband

definitions.text: urges one to have a flutter
definitions.meaning: read as an imperative, '...!', urging someone to bet

explanation.definitionFit: A titled widow with estate inherited from her husband; and split in two, the word is a command to place a bet.

clue.text: Go off with a politician after a month

indicators.note: the politician with a comes after the month, so the month's abbreviation leads

parts.note: DEC is the abbreviation for December
MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: Someone is told to leave in the company of a politician once a month has passed.
explanation.definitionFit: To decamp is to leave suddenly, to make off or depart.

clue.text: Public protests by the people

definitions.meaning: marches and rallies, plural of a short word for demonstration
the Greek word for the populace, used in politics

explanation.definitionFit: It is the plural of the short form of demonstration and also the ordinary citizenry as a political body.

clue.text: Study links a lot of men together

parts.note: to con is to study or learn
links is a golf course

explanation.walkthrough: 'Links' looks like a verb but is a seaside golf course.
explanation.definitionFit: A concourse is a crowd or gathering of people.

clue.text: Doctors on leave appeal for a malaria carrier

indicators.note: in a down clue the doctors sit on top of what follows

parts.note: MOs are medical officers
to quit is to leave
O is an exclamation of appeal, as in 'O God'

explanation.surface: Doctors on leave make a plea about an insect spreading disease.
explanation.definitionFit: The female Anopheles insect transmits the malaria parasite.

clue.text: To break the record, get away fast

definitions.meaning: to surpass a best mark, i.e. beat that record
slang command to clear off quickly

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to better the record; the other is the slang order to scram, leave in a hurry.

clue.text: Feminine desire to go round a Gulf state

indicators.note: the word for desire is set to encircle the Gulf state, so the state sits inside it

parts.note: a desire is a wish
Oman is a state on the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea

explanation.surface: A woman's wish to travel around a Middle Eastern country.
explanation.definitionFit: Womanish means characteristic of a woman, often used of a man in a mildly derogatory way.

clue.text: Salesman guilty of misrepresentation when answering queries

parts.note: REP, short for sales representative
telling untruths, i.e. lying

explanation.surface: A dishonest salesman fibs when customers ask him questions.
explanation.definitionFit: Responding to questions is giving replies to them.

clue.text: Audibly present arms to an oriental warlord

indicators.note: the phrase for presenting arms is to be heard spoken rather than read

parts.note: to present arms could be read as to show a gun

explanation.surface: A soldier salutes a Japanese commander by presenting arms with a shout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Present arms' is a drill command, but here it means literally show (a) gun, which said aloud sounds like the warlord's title.
explanation.definitionFit: A shogun was a hereditary military commander who ruled Japan in place of the emperor.

clue.text: Should the Chancellor cut it to rouse enthusiasm with speed?

parts.note: to interest someone is to arouse their enthusiasm
speed is a rate

explanation.surface: A question whether the finance minister should make a cut that would quickly stir excitement.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chancellor of the Exchequer is the UK finance minister; cutting the bank's lending rate is a classic way to stimulate the economy.
explanation.definitionFit: The cost of borrowing is something a finance minister may lower to boost spending.

clue.text: Broke when novel isn't republished

indicators.note: a book reissued in a new form, so the letters of novel and isn't are rearranged

parts.note: the apostrophe is ignored

explanation.surface: An author goes bankrupt when a book is not reprinted.
explanation.definitionFit: Insolvent means unable to pay debts, penniless.

clue.text: Extant art form

definitions.meaning: a painting of inanimate objects such as fruit or flowers

explanation.definitionFit: Split cryptically it means still living, i.e. surviving; it is also a genre of painting of objects.

clue.text: Quite certain which terminal carries a plus sign

definitions.text: which terminal carries a plus sign
definitions.meaning: the battery terminal marked + is called the anode side

explanation.definitionFit: It means completely sure, and is the name of the battery terminal marked with a plus.

clue.text: Party voters can reform before I have

indicators.note: the rearranged letters come before the contraction for I have
to reform is to reshape, so the letters of voters and can are rearranged

parts.note: I have contracts to I've

explanation.surface: A political call for voters to reform before the speaker has something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Party' looks like part of the surface's politics but is the definition; 'reform' is the anagram signal on the nine letters of the two words, and 'before' places them ahead of the contraction.
explanation.definitionFit: The Conservatives are a major British political party, the Tories.

clue.text: Date-pad must be modified

indicators.note: changed in form, so the letters of the date pad are rearranged

explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue serves as definition too: the letters of a date pad, modified, are themselves a modified result.
explanation.definitionFit: Adapted means altered to suit, the same as modified.

clue.text: Finishing up as a big noise in engineering

indicators.note: the big noise is placed inside the abbreviation for engineering

parts.note: ENG is a standard abbreviation for engineering
a din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: A loud racket in a workshop at the end of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Ending means concluding, bringing to a close.

clue.text: Complete form to restore gas level

definitions.meaning: to fill in every blank on a document
to top up a fuel tank completely; gas is American for petrol

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both to fill in a document fully and to replenish a tank to the brim.

clue.text: Apt way to write 2+1

parts.note: PR is the abbreviation for pair, which is two
one in words

explanation.surface: A neat way to write a sum.
explanation.walkthrough: '2+1' looks like arithmetic, but 2 is a pair, abbreviated PR, followed by ONE.
explanation.definitionFit: Prone means inclined or liable, as is apt in 'apt to sulk'.

clue.text: Agreeing that everything is outstanding

parts.note: everything is all
an outstanding debt is owing, still unpaid

explanation.surface: Accepting that every debt remains unpaid.
explanation.definitionFit: Allowing is permitting or conceding, a form of assent.

clue.text: Widows' habits prove a trial to husbandmen

explanation.definitionFit: Mourning garments worn by a bereaved wife share the word with wild plants that plague farmers.

clue.text: Landlord to a huge number of colliers

indicators.note: the huge number is made up of the colliers' word, which therefore comes first

parts.note: colliers work in a mine, so their place stands for them
a host is a great multitude

explanation.surface: A publican serving a great crowd of coal miners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mine host' is an old jocular term for an innkeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic, jocular phrase for the keeper of an inn or pub.

clue.text: One Stalinist police chief in SW Europe

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral
Lavrentiy Beria headed Stalin's secret police, the NKVD

explanation.surface: A Soviet security chief is posted to the south-west of the continent.
explanation.definitionFit: The Iberian Peninsula, holding Spain and Portugal, occupies the south-west corner of the continent.

clue.text: Well-bred maggot

definitions.meaning: an angler's name for a blowfly larva used as bait

explanation.definitionFit: The word once meant of noble birth, and anglers use it for the larva of a bluebottle used as bait.

clue.text: Equestrian display in an era of elegance

indicators.note: the era is one of elegance, so the elegance word comes first

parts.note: dress, as in fine clothes or formal dress, suggests elegance
an era is an age

explanation.surface: Horses showing off in a period of refinement.
explanation.definitionFit: Dressage is the training and exhibition of a horse in precise, controlled movements.
